suggestions.title: Mara's map at the crowning
suggestions.premise: On coronation day the harbour is closed to everyone but the crown's ships, and Mara's map marks a cove just past the chain. She wants to slip out while every eye is on the ceremony.

suggestions.title: The ledger changes hands
suggestions.premise: The harbour ledger is to be handed to the new crown's treasurer during the coronation. Seraphine Vale knows the route the courier will walk.

suggestions.title: Debts called in at the feast
suggestions.premise: Every creditor on the Saltmarch waterfront turns up to the coronation feast. Seraphine's debts are the talk of the long tables.
